        self.actions_log.append("Clipping VehAge (<=20), DrivAge (<=90), BonusMalus (<=150), ClaimNb (<=5).")

        data['BonusMalus'] = data['BonusMalus'].clip(upper=150)

        # Encode categorical variables
        data['Area'] = data['Area'].astype('category').cat.codes + 1
        data['VehBrand'] = data['VehBrand'].astype('category').cat.codes + 1
        data['VehGas'] = data['VehGas'].astype('category').cat.codes + 1
        data['Region'] = data['Region'].astype('category').cat.codes + 1

        # Standardize numerical variables
        from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
        scaler = StandardScaler()
        num_vars = ['ClaimNb', 'Exposure', 'VehPower', 'VehAge', 'DrivAge', 'BonusMalus', 'Density']
        data[num_vars] = scaler.fit_transform(data[num_vars])
